name: pack_context
title: Pack context
description: Build a bundle of code and evidence that fits a token budget: the targets, or the top symbol matches for a question, as seeds, followed by their neighbors, the tests that cover them, and their recent history, as include asks. Give targets, a question, or both. The same index and arguments always give the same bundle. Tokens are estimated as ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4). Each section says why it was included and what it cost, and omitted lists what didn't fit or was withheld.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

targets.description: Node IDs or path:line locators to use as seeds.

question.description: Its top symbol matches become seeds.

sections.description: Seeds first, then neighbors, tests, and history, each by relevance.

why.description: Why it is included, like 'calls seed 1' or 'top match for the question'.

reason.description: withheld: the sensitivity rules keep its content out.
